2.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-8 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: The petitioners in the present writ petition, have raised a grievance with regard to non-release of the assessed compensation amount for acquisition of land belonging to the petitioners.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-8 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: The petitioner have further prayed that they being the co-pattadar of the said land, the respondent authorities are required to release a proportionate share of the compensation amount as assessed to the petitioners, in the matter.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-8 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: Page No.# 1/8 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144648263/
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-8 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: 2 3. As projected in the writ petition, the father of the petitioners, namely, Sk. Sahid Hussain and one Sk. Hamid Ali were the joint pattadar and possessors of a plot of land measuring 4B-4K-14L covered by Dag No. 49 of Patta No. 5, of village Haldibari under Mouza Kaziranga under Golaghat District.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-8 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: The father of the petitioners passed on, on 10- 09-1985, living behind the mother of the petitioners and the petitioners as his next of kin.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-8 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: It is projected that the mother had also subsequently passed on.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-8 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: The petitioners being the legal heirs of late Sahid Hussain, being in possession of the land, were paying revenue to the Revenue Department.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-8 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: 4. It is under above circumstances that the respondent authorities had proceeded to acquire the land possessed by the petitioners for the purpose of the 5 th addition to Kaziranga National Park.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-8 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: Accordingly, a notice dated 08-03-2023 came to be issued in the name of the deceased father of the petitioners, with regard to acquisition of the land in the possession of the petitioners and assessment of compensation thereof.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-8 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: The compensation for acquisition of the land was so assessed as Rs. 19,30,125/- (Nineteen Lakhs Thirty Thousand One hundred Twenty-five).
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-8 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: The petitioners on receipt of the said Page No.# 4/8 notice approached the respondent No. 5, with all requisite documents and had prayed for release to them of their due share of the compensation amount assessed for the land so acquired from them.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-8 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: It is to be noted that the acquisition was made in respect of 2B-4K- 14L out of the land possessed by the petitioners and the co-pattadar.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-8 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: 5. The respondent authorities having not released the compensation, as assessed in the matter to the petitioners, even such release being not made with regard to the extent of the share of the petitioners in the land in question, the petitioners have instituted the present proceeding with the prayers, as noticed, hereinabove.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-8 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text:
6. Mr. N.K. Kalita, learned counsel for the petitioners after reiterating the facts noticed,
hereinabove, has submitted that the respondent authorities even after assessing due compensation receivable by the petitioners, have not released the same, inasmuch as the co-pattadars of the plot of land in question, had not appeared before the respondent authorities for completion of the requisite formalities.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-8 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 4 September, 2025.json
